fields.label: LLC. Enter the tax classification (C = C corporation, S = S corporation, P = Partnership)
fields.notes: Only applicable/fillable when the LLC box in line 3a is checked; conditional field.

fields.label: Other (see instructions)
fields.notes: Free-text entry line next to the 'Other' checkbox in line 3a; conditional on that box being checked. Label text is identical to one of the 'tax-classification' choice values above -- ambiguous by string alone, disambiguate by field_kind/section position.

fields.label: check this box if you have any foreign partners, owners, or beneficiaries
fields.notes: Part of the longer line 3b instruction ('If on line 3a you checked "Partnership" or "Trust/estate," ... check this box if you have any foreign partners, owners, or beneficiaries. See instructions.'); conditional on line 3a selection.

fields.label: Exemption from Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) reporting code (if any)

fields.label: Social security number
fields.notes: Filer provides either the SSN box or the EIN box, not both; form presents them as two separate boxed entry areas joined by 'or' rather than a checkbox choice group.
